0541Mathematics

Procedural Pile

reasoning-core/procedural-pile

Solve generated reasoning problems from 55 families (arithmetic, logic, proofs, planning, SQL, grammars) with short answers.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • SFT and mid-training data
  • verifiable RL problems across many families

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Not stated

Every answer is computed by a solver or checked by a verifier, not written by a language model.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

from datasets import load_dataset

ds = load_dataset("reasoning-core/procedural-pile", split="train", streaming=True)
print(next(iter(ds))["prompt"])

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download reasoning-core/procedural-pile --repo-type dataset --local-dir procedural-pile

Framework documentation: OpenEnv, Verifiers.

Evidence

A 3B model trained on the first release reaches the highest mean DROP, LogiQA and ARC-Challenge scores among compared procedural collections.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
